name: mashina_top
how: am start -n deepal.com.cn.app/.SplashActivity, wait for the car (Машина) tab to load

name: mashina_scroll
how: from mashina_top: swipe up once (script does it), wait for content to settle

name: dialog_keyless
how: Машинa → keyless driving (Бесключевое вождение) toggle → dialog «Включите бесключевое вождение» stays open (WAIT=45)

name: service_deepal_grid
how: tab Сервис → section Сервис Deepal (4x2 icon grid)

name: service_acc
how: tab Сервис → accordion rows (Автогид/Карта зарядок) area

name: settings_car
how: Мой/Настройки → car settings page (vehicle 车辆设置)

name: trip_info
how: Машинa → trip/charge history card (Порт Хоргос area)
